department: Department of Chemistry, Biochemistry and Pharmaceutical Sciences (Faculty of Science)

deadline.value: Doctoral applications at the University of Bern are accepted throughout the year once a thesis supervisor agrees (fall semester registration runs September 1 to October 15).
deadline.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must be accepted by a research group before you can join the chemistry PhD programme.
supervisor.quote: be accepted in one of the research groups at DCBP

funding.value: The chemistry page gives no funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: You need a Master of Science (MSc) to join the chemistry PhD programme.
entry_route.quote: you need to hold an MSc (Master in Sciences)

notes: Taught in English, 3 to 4 years. Admission is through a research group at the department.
